name: Suud Suud Jai / Put Your Heart Into It
Kra Ten Kong Hua Jai / Heartbeat
Jai Kwang / Unknown / Open-Minded
desc: Bouldery and powerful start. Bouldery and powerful start and a great thin slab section. Bit of a squeeze job, but none the less, a great line! Hardest route at the lower sector of Heart Wall.

name: Pah Dtat Hua Jai / Heart Surgery
desc: Enjoyable pumpy climbing on good rock all the way to the top. Quick link lower offs.

name: Mar Jark Jai / Heartfelt
desc: Great line for the grade and a stunning pump fest to the top from the half way point.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Because of the bird‘s nest in the vicinity, please avoid this route for 2 months.

name: Tang Jai / Intentions
desc: Cool climbing on great rock. The big flake is a wonderful feature and super knee bar friendly no matter your size.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Active owl nest behind big flake, 2 eggs. Please avoid this climb for a while.

name: Deung Duut Jai / Attractive
desc: Awesome technical climbing at the grade with a lovely decision for all at the lip.....do I go left or right?
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Because of the bird‘s nest in the vicinity, please avoid this route for 2 months.

name: Jai Tuud / Wimp
desc: Very unique climbing for the grade on a great clump of rock. Unusual indeed.

name: Jai Rag / I Love My Heart
Kob Jai Lai Lai / Thank You Very Much
Rang Lai Jai / Hesitate
desc: It climbs ok and it's a bit of fun.

name: Song Jit Song Jai / I'm Torn
desc: Fun to play on for the grade.

name: Jai Ngai / Gullible
desc: Technical crux cross through with a delightful finish. Worth the effort!

name: Jai Yen Yen / Patient / The Proposal / Calm
Jai Glah Reu Plao / Are You Courageous?
desc: Stunning climbing all the way to the anchors. It really doesn't get more enjoyable than this. Get on it!

name: Dee Jai Tee Dai Geud / It's Great to be Alive
Dtat Sin Jai / Decide
desc: Powerful climbing on steep terrain. As the name says "Decide".

name: Jai Det / Fearless
desc: Tough and short with a balancy committing finish. Little runout with a dodgy fall possibility. Pull hard youngsters.

name: Pak Jai / Rest Your Heart
desc: Its all there, you just need to find it all. Good climbing.

name: Blaek Jai / Surprised / Wondering
desc: Very unusual rock with a nice little touch of "Weird" attached. Have Fun!

name: Bratup Jai / Impressed
desc: Technical thrutchy start then you're off and running........and you will be....Impressed.

name: Jai Rawn / Hot Headed
desc: Absolutely stunning for the grade. Varied and powerful in spots.

name: Ruam Jai / Together
desc: This is the best at the grade in the area. Simply stunning climbing all the way to the top. The route can be climbed with 60m rope, it has an anchor at 20m (just over the big tufa).

name: Jai Teung Jai / Heart to Heart
Jai Loy / Spaced-Out
desc: Sleep climbing through tufas, with a powerful pull over the lip to balancy stance a little way above your last bolt.....hence the name.

name: Dtang Jai / Conscious
desc: Great climbing on beautiful rock. Go for the onsight!

name: Hua Jai Wai / Heart Attack
desc: Super bouldery and thrutchy from the ground to the anchors. Do if that sort of thing suits you.

name: Duang Jai / Heart / Flame Heart
desc: Go and go left and then left again and up and then up again. First anchor at 22 metres, then final anchor at 25 metres. Great route. Pain to clean. Heart in the cragfinder app.

name: Kuu Jai / Twin Heart
desc: Nice varied climbing for the grade. Short but value packed. Quick links at the anchors.

name: Dtok Jai / Startled
desc: Great fun climbing with a sting in the tail. Pull hard for the on-sight.

name: Peaun Jai Rai / My Friend is Mean
desc: Super fun, super easy and all the way to the top. Sometime you even get monkeys at the anchors trying to steal your quick draws. Take a spare if you're the second on the route. You have been warned.

name: Inferno
desc: 9 bolts and 1 thread.

name: All Quiet on the Eastern Front
desc: 8 bolts and 1 thread.

name: The Lemons and Lives of Reason
Stranger At The Gate
desc: Starting from the first pitch of In Deep Space, traverse left. After three bolts you will see bolts heading upwards but ignore those and continue left. 5a 10 bolts. first pitch of In Deep Space 6a 15 bolts. traverse left. 7a+ 11 bolts 6a+ 9 bolts 6b 11 bolts

name: Pining For Darkness
desc: Also starts from the anchors of the first pitch of In Deep Space. 5a 10 bolts. first pitch of In Deep Space 5c 11 bolts 6a 20 bolts 4 4 bolts

name: The Sound Of Darkness
desc: Also starts from the anchors of the first pitch of In Deep Space. 5a 10 bolts. first pitch of In Deep Space 5a 8 bolts 6b 12 bolts 4 9 bolts

name: Innocence Lost
desc: Climb up the first pitch of Deep Space. From the anchors, traverse left for 3 bolts then follow the line upwards. When this splits, follow the left line of bolts to another anchor. From this anchor, take the left line of bolts.

name: Till We Meet Again
desc: Climb up Deep Space P1, then Innocence Lost until the anchor. From this anchor, take the right line up.

name: The Darkness Beckons
desc: From the anchors of In Deep Space P1, traverse 3 bolts left then climb upwards. After a few bolts follow the right line of bolts until it splits again. Follow the left line from here. Abseil down the line.

name: In Deep Space
desc: A four pitch climb that starts on the left face of the cave after walking in from the lower entrance. Goes all the way to the top of the cave for a great view of the cave below and the Mae On country side. Lots of loose rock so check everything before pulling on it and wear a helmet! 25m. 10 bolts. 25m. 11 bolts. Traverse 3 bolts right then head straight up. After a few bolts it splits again. Follow the right path until it splits again. Straight up is the 6a. This time the split takes a sharp right and you even traverse downwards to get to the next anchor. 30m. 17 bolts. 10m. 7 bolts. Continue up the cave exit. Belay from bolts. A rappel station is 2m climber's left of this belay station. For the rappel, you can do 2 rappels outside of the cave or 3 rappels inside the cave (70m rope)

name: Spaceman Pitch 1
desc: Climb without using ferrata.

name: Space Manouevers Pitch 1
desc: Steep and sustained, all the way!

name: Anxiety State Crisis / Anxiety State Crisis Pitch 2
desc: Anxiety State Crisis takes a line up a featured pillar in the center of the cave.

name: Walk the Plank
desc: Accessed from halfway up Reunion Pitch 3. Belay anchor is inside the cave. Finish on the same anchors as Reunion Pitch 3.

name: Handsome and Old
desc: Located to the right of Reunion. Figure out the tricky start and then climb through huecos to an anchor at the headwall. From the anchors, you can veer left and continue onto the 2nd pitch of Reunion.

name: Moving'Through Your System
desc: Shares a start with Lust. Right hand finish.

name: Forge
desc: Access pitch for Live By Night and Body Shine

name: Live By Night
desc: Left hand extension of Forge.

name: Body Shine
desc: Right hand extension of Forge

name: Loneliness of the Long Distance Driller
In Through The Outdoor
desc: On the right inside the cave that leads to Anxiety State Crisis. Rungs at the top. Leads to a ledge with 4 more routes.

name: True North
desc: Access to the ledge for the next 4 routes can be made by either In Through The Outside, or Left To My Own Devices.

name: Happiness Happening
desc: On the ledge above In Through The Outdoor.

name: Left To My Own Devices
desc: Access pitch to the ledge with 4 routes.

name: Northern Exposure
desc: To the first anchor.

name: Northern Exposure Ext
desc: Climb as one pitch for the 6b.

name: The Shining Path
desc: 7 bolts and 5 threads.

name: Unnamed Japanese Route
desc: The route is in your left side just coming into the cave, in front of Cool and Funky

name: Holding the Zero
desc: The same anchor of 'Cool and Funky'

name: Cool and Funky
desc: Just inside the cave to the right.Trend up and left through steep terrain on holds that are as good as you can hope for. Pull over bulge, ignore the anchor on the right which is for Welcome to the Wonderwall, continue up left.

name: Welcome to the Wonderworld
desc: Located just inside the mouth of the cave on the right side. (To the right of Cool and Funky). Start just to the left of a pile of bamboo. Be careful and try not to fall during the first 2 bolts; the bamboo can injure you.

name: The Foaming Pumpus
desc: First 3 bolts of the Wild Pumpus, then the go left to Foaming at the Mouth.

name: Wild & Free
desc: This line begins on "The Wild Pumpus/Foaming Pumpus" for the first 4 bolts through the boulder problem, then traverses left into the second bolt of "Freeblast" and the rest of the route. Unclip the second bolt of "Freeblast" after clipping the third to reduce rope drag.

name: Show Off the Police
desc: The first route at Crazy Horse

name: Trojan Horse
desc: 5c, Pitch 1: Straightforward, juggy face climbing. 15m, 10 bolts 6a+, Pitch 2: 25m, 15 bolts. Climb the face and finish at a set of rappel rings and rap down or veer left to another set of anchors and the 3rd pitch of the climb. 5a, Pitch 3, 15m, 6 bolts. Easier climbing. Belay from the first set of anchors you see. Rap off the next set of rap rings. 60 meter rope will get you to the ground (tie knots) It is a good idea to check for bees before you climb this route. The final rappel descends right in front of bee hives where the route "A Wild Ride on a Crazy Horse" is located.

name: Mai Roo Reuang / I Have No Idea
The Thai Who Loved Me
desc: Access this route from the top of "Magic Drop" or "Reindeer request"

name: Partners Left
desc: Starts at the top of Reindeer Request

name: Partners Right
desc: Starts at the top of Reindeer Request. Go right after first bolt.

name: A Horse with No Name
desc: Starts at top of Ding Dong. 5a pitch is a traverse.

name: It's Got to Be Funky
desc: Starts from top of Bamboo Finders.

name: Headhunters Pitch 2
desc: Starts at top of Blood, Love and Steel Pitch 1.

name: Free the Spirit
desc: Starts at the top of Headhunters Pitch 2.

name: Baby Rock
desc: Starts at top of Blood, Love and Steel Pitch 1.

name: A Wild Ride on a Crazy Horse
desc: Watch for the bees.

name: Just Give me More
desc: Starts at the top of Dangerous Joy.

name: The Horse Knows the Way
desc: The route was first graded 7c. For the 7c take the jug in the bottom of the big hole (in the right of the third bolt) and then up and right.

name: Don't Look a Gifthorse in the Mouth Pitch 1
Don't Look a Gifthorse in the Mouth Pitch 2
Robert's Stress
desc: Polished feet and stiff moves up the left leaning crack. Better holds up the face, pull onto ledge, then up right. Jugs above the chains (though no doubt you will clip from the small holds below!).

name: Groove is in the Heart
desc: Hard move to pocket down low. Continue up steep corner with nice moves. Pull over lip, past ledge then follow next 2 bolts to the anchor.

name: Drill and Blast, Drill and Bolt
Crazy Hot
desc: Use long draws on the 4th, 5th and 6th bolts. You can use this route to access Route #21 at The Crazy Horse Area West Face.

name: Sage
setter: Uthit Yodkhaman, Amelia Beaudoin & Eric Mize, 2003

name: Makham Wan / Tamarind Leaves
desc: 2 pitch route at the far left of Tamarind Village. 20m (5a) Climb a slabby face with good holds to a generous belay stance. 25m (5c+) Climb a longer and more strenuous pitch to another nice belay ledge. You can rappel back to the ground with a single 70m rope (tie knots at the end). The vertical displacement of the rappel is just under 35m.

name: Chimney Creep
desc: Same climb as The Chimney Sweep but without the rear wall.

name: Makhaam Bpriaao
desc: Right hand route at mouth of chimney. Stiff first moves. Well bolted.

name: The Queen Bee
desc: Climb the striking arete past 5 bolts.
Up blocks, small gully and onto face. Varied moves and beautiful holds where you need them. Remember to look at the view.

name: Another Snake In A Break
desc: Part of Tamarind Wall according to the Cragfinder App and possibly misnamed as there are errors.

name: Once We Were Young
desc: Climbs on large features and splits off left from another route just before an overhang.

name: Low Hanging Fruit
desc: Splits off to the right just before the overhang.

name: Ling Jaw Jaw / Really Handsome
desc: Interesting route with some nice moves

name: Man on the Run / Left variation
desc: This route shares the first bolt with the 7a+ on its right. For the 6b stay Left and follow the bolts straight up

name: Jesse James / Right variation
desc: The first bolt is in common with the 6b. Follow the Right line of bolts, up onto the overhanging bulge, and up

name: Heavy Drilling
desc: Climbs into the large crack. The first two bolts are in common with the 6a. Split left immediately above the third bolt onto the bulge if you want to keep the grade. Stay on the line of bolts on the arete and DO NOT veer right on the 6a. The start and finish is the same as the 6a on the right.

name: Fast Living
desc: Climb up into the wide crack, then split right and climb the face with mantel ledges. Same start and finish as the 7a on the left.

name: Names And Number Plates
desc: Left of two routes on the north facing corner. A couple of meters to the right of "Monkey Around"

name: Call The Police
desc: Right of two routes on the north facing corner.

name: Aom Sim
desc: Lefthand route on the back wall.

name: Snake In A Break
desc: Second route from the left of the back wall.

name: Miya Arom Siya / My Girlfriend Is In A Bad Mood
